# UK GDAD PCF

> An open, community-built companion to the UK Government Digital and Data
> (GDAD) Profession Capability Framework (PCF). Restates the official
> framework as plain, parseable files — one per role level — and extends it
> with eight further documents per level: a start-here orientation,
> upskilling resources, a continuing professional development checklist, an
> assessor-administered psychometric assessment, a self-practice psychometric
> assessment, an assessor-administered competency assessment, a self-rating
> competency assessment, and a skills gap form. Published as a static website
> at https://uk-gdad.github.io. This is not a government service: role
> summaries are Crown copyright, adapted under the Open Government Licence
> v3.0; everything else is AI-assisted with human review. Nothing here should
> be the sole basis for a pay, grading, recruitment or promotion decision —
> use the official framework and talk to your organisation for anything that
> carries that weight.

## Start here

- [spec/index.md](spec/index.md): The single source of truth — taxonomy, the
  role index, document contracts, writing style, licensing, validation.
  Every rule that can be checked mechanically is enforced by `bin/check`.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Working notes for an AI agent contributing here,
  pulling in the whole `AGENTS/` directory.
- [README.md](README.md): Human-facing orientation — what is here, quick
  start, how it fits together.
- [index.md](index.md): The manual — tutorials, reference, recipes, and
  answers to common questions.

## The nine role-level projects

One canonical project defines which of the 205 role levels exist; eight
derived projects mirror its index exactly, one document per role level each.

- [uk-gdad-pcf-role-summaries](uk-gdad-pcf-role-summaries/README.md):
  **Canonical.** The framework restated as plain text, one file per role
  level — the role, the level, its accountabilities, and its skills.
- [uk-gdad-pcf-role-level-start-here](uk-gdad-pcf-role-level-start-here/README.md):
  A first orientation and learning pathway for each role level, linking out
  to every sibling document.
- [uk-gdad-pcf-upskilling-resources](uk-gdad-pcf-upskilling-resources/README.md):
  Courses, blog posts, research, videos and books for each role level.
- [uk-gdad-pcf-continuing-professional-development-checklists](uk-gdad-pcf-continuing-professional-development-checklists/README.md):
  A CPD checklist per role level — general sections shared by every file,
  plus one section of role-specific things to do.
- [uk-gdad-pcf-psychometric-assessments-by-assessor](uk-gdad-pcf-psychometric-assessments-by-assessor/README.md):
  Assessor-administered cognitive, numeric, verbal and situational judgement
  items, per role level, with the answer key held back from the candidate.
- [uk-gdad-pcf-psychometric-assessments-by-yourself](uk-gdad-pcf-psychometric-assessments-by-yourself/README.md):
  The same four assessment types as practice material, for the reader to
  work through alone.
- [uk-gdad-pcf-competency-assessments-by-assessor](uk-gdad-pcf-competency-assessments-by-assessor/README.md):
  A skill-by-skill competency matrix, per role level, for an assessor to
  rate a candidate or employee against a 0–4 proficiency scale.
- [uk-gdad-pcf-competency-assessments-by-yourself](uk-gdad-pcf-competency-assessments-by-yourself/README.md):
  The same matrix, generated from its sibling, for the reader to rate
  themselves against.
- [uk-gdad-pcf-roles-skills-gap-forms](uk-gdad-pcf-roles-skills-gap-forms/README.md):
  A form human resources sends and an employee fills in, one per role level,
  covering job tasks, skills, legal compliance and development priorities.

## Other projects

- [uk-gdad-pcf-skills-self-assessment](uk-gdad-pcf-skills-self-assessment/README.md):
  A standalone, single-page tool for rating yourself against every skill in
  the framework's catalogue, independent of any one role level.
- [uk-gdad.github.io](uk-gdad.github.io/README.md): The SvelteKit project
  that publishes everything above as the static website at
  https://uk-gdad.github.io.

## Reference

- [AGENTS/taxonomy.md](AGENTS/taxonomy.md): The four nouns — profession,
  role, role level, skill — and the eight professions.
- [AGENTS/writing.md](AGENTS/writing.md): Writing style — register,
  tone, the serial comma, en-GB spelling, and their documented exceptions.
- [spec/skills.md](spec/skills.md): The 183-skill catalogue and how it
  compares against the framework's own published list.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Notable changes, grouped by the date they
  landed.
- [llms.json](llms.json): This same map, plus the taxonomy and project list,
  as structured data.
